noPermission.title: Moving goods is not open to you here
noPermission.body: Moves need the permission to move stock. Ask your team leader.

offline.line: No network: a move is kept on this tablet and sent when the network is back. Undo waits for the network.

scan.label: Scan what you move
scan.hint: A lot, a hide, a roll or a remnant label

waiting.title: Waiting to be moved

empty.title: Nothing waits to be moved
empty.body: Scan any lot, hide or roll to move it.

waiting.error: Your tasks could not be read. Scan to move anyway.
waiting.notOnTablet: Your tasks are not on this tablet. Scan to move anyway.
waiting.more: More wait: the first {count} are shown, the next first.

task.scanGoods: Scan {code} to start: its label confirms what you move.
task.scanItem: Scan the label of {item} at {from} to start.
task.scanQuarantine: Scan the quarantine place {place}: the scan confirms the move.
task.scanQuarantineAny: Scan the label of the quarantine place: the scan confirms the move.

flag.hold: On a quality hold: it goes only into a quarantine place
flag.notReleased: Not released by quality: it goes only into a quarantine place
flag.quarantine: Quality asks: move it to quarantine {place}
flag.quarantineAny: Quality asks: move it to quarantine
flag.wholeLot: Hide by hide: every hide of it there moves

suggestion.DEFAULT: Put it in {place}: the default place for this kind
suggestion.SAME_LOT: Put it in {place}: where the same lot lies
suggestion.QUALITY: Put it in {place}: the quality place

blind.body: Scan the place: the move waits on this tablet and the office checks it when the network is back.

from.title: Where do you take it from?
from.hint: It lies in {count} places: tap the one you take it from.

scan.label: Scan the place
scan.hint: The bin label is the confirmation
scan.to: Put it in {place}: scan its label
scan.quarantineAny: Scan the label of the quarantine place

held.from: Tap first where you take it from
held.nothing: Nothing of it lies at this site

last.refused: The office refused the move of {code} to {to}: open Waiting to send to see why.

NOTHING_HERE.fix: There is nothing to move: scan another label.

NAME_THE_PLACE.fix: Tap where you take it from, then scan the place again.

SAME_PLACE.fix: Scan the label of the place you put it in.

ARCHIVED.fix: Nothing goes into it: scan another place.

QUARANTINE_ONLY.message: Not released by quality: it goes only into a quarantine place
QUARANTINE_ONLY.fix: Scan the label of a quarantine place. Quality releases it first for an open shelf.

WHOLE_ONLY.fix: Move all of it: a hide or a roll is never split by a move.

TOO_MUCH.message: Less lies there than you typed
TOO_MUCH.fix: Type at most what lies there.

NOT_A_QUARANTINE_PLACE.fix: Scan the label of the quarantine place.
NOT_A_QUARANTINE_PLACE.fixAsked: Scan the label of the quarantine place {asked}.

LOCATION_BLOCKED.fix: Nothing moves in or out until the office unblocks it. Scan another place.

COUNT_FROZEN.message: A count is counting this material there
COUNT_FROZEN.fix: Its moves wait until the count line is counted. Ask your team leader.

TRANSIT_ONLY_TRANSFER.message: Goods in transit move only with their transfer
TRANSIT_ONLY_TRANSFER.fix: The office ships or receives the transfer.

NOT_A_PLACE.message: No place of this site carries the label {place}
NOT_A_PLACE.fix: Scan the label of a place here: a place of another site is refused.

DOES_NOT_HOLD.fix: Materials go to material places, finished garments to finished goods: scan another place.

NOT_STOCK.message: Nothing at this site carries the label {code}
NOT_STOCK.fix: Scan a lot, a hide, a roll or a remnant's tag first, then the place.

NOT_YOURS.message: Only who made a move undoes it
NOT_YOURS.fix: Ask the office to reverse it.

TOO_LATE.message: A move is undone within 2 minutes
TOO_LATE.fix: Move it back with two scans, or ask the office to reverse it.

NOT_A_MOVE.message: Only a move made by scan is undone here
NOT_A_MOVE.fix: A roll moves back with a scan of it and of its place; the office reverses other moves.

TAKEN_BY_OTHER.fix: It is in their hands: pick another one.

NOT_FOR_YOU.message: This task is for someone else
NOT_FOR_YOU.fix: It is not in your list: pick another one.

SCAN_THE_PLACE.message: Scan the label of the quarantine place

STILL_THERE.message: It still lies where it was
STILL_THERE.fix: Scan it, then scan the place you put it in.

NOT_ALLOWED.message: This needs a permission you do not have here

CONFLICT.message: The office could not take the move as it is
CONFLICT.fix: Open Waiting to send to see why.

BADGE.message: This badge did not open the tablet
BADGE.fix: The person on the tablet stays signed in.

inbox.title: My work
inbox.status: Your warehouse tasks, the next first
inbox.statusAsOf: Your warehouse tasks, from this tablet as of {time}

empty.title: Nothing waits for you
empty.body: Scan a lot, a hide or a roll to move it, or a work order's traveller to pick for it.

error.title: Your tasks could not be read

offline.line: No network: Take, Give back and Done are kept on this tablet and sent when the network is back.
offline.title: Your tasks are not on this tablet
offline.body: No network, and this tablet has not read them in this visit. Scan to work anyway.

noPermission.title: Your tasks are not open to you here
noPermission.body: The warehouse inbox needs floor work at this site. Ask your team leader.

gone.title: This task is no longer in your list
gone.body: Done, given to someone else or cancelled in the office. Go back to your list.

inbox.more: More wait: the first {count} are shown, the next first.

scan.label: Scan a label
scan.hint: A lot or a hide opens Move & put away; a traveller opens Pick & issue

how.move: Scan {code}, then the label of the place you put it in.
how.moveItem: Scan the goods' label, then the place's.
how.quarantine: Quality's hold: move the goods to {place} and scan its label.
how.quarantineAny: Quality's hold: move the goods to quarantine and scan the place's label.
how.receive: Take the delivery in on Receive; the receipt closes this task.
how.pick: Pick on Pick & issue: scan the work order's traveller there.
how.countAt: Count what lies at {place}, then tap Done.

held.noScreen: That screen is not open to you here
held.scanPlace: Scan the quarantine place: the scan confirms the move

step.giveBack: Given back: {task} is open for others

refusal.NOT_TAKEN: Nobody has it: there is nothing to give back.
refusal.NOT_YOURS: Only who took it gives it back.
refusal.SCAN_THE_PLACE: Scan the quarantine place: the scan confirms the move.
refusal.STILL_THERE: The goods still lie where they were: scan them, then the place you put them in.
refusal.NOT_ALLOWED: This needs a permission you do not have here.
refusal.CONFLICT: The office could not take it: open Waiting to send to see why.
